review: 702.35c: the skip claimed no Forge card can refer to the discarded card after the madness trigger resolves, but a 'whenever you discard' trigger such as Containment Construct's triggers alongside the madness trigger and can resolve after it; removed the skip and added 702.35c-1 with fires (uncast, found in graveyard), cast_with_madness and trigger-order does_not_fire variants.

scenarios.title: A discarded madness card is exiled instead, and may be cast for its madness cost
decisions: A casts Tormenting Voice, tapping two Mountains, discarding Fiery Temper as its additional cost.
The madness trigger goes on the stack above Tormenting Voice. When it resolves A casts Fiery Temper for its madness cost {R} (tapping the third Mountain), targeting player B.
Both players pass; Fiery Temper resolves, then Tormenting Voice resolves.

variants.label: cast
variants.expected: Fiery Temper is exiled instead of going to the graveyard when discarded, then cast for {R}: it deals 3 damage to B (life 20 to 17) and is put into A's graveyard after it resolves. Tormenting Voice then draws A two cards.

variants.label: declined
variants.delta: A chooses not to cast Fiery Temper when the madness trigger resolves.
variants.expected: Fiery Temper is exiled when discarded, then put into A's graveyard by the trigger. B's life stays 20. A draws two cards.

variants.label: cost_unpayable
variants.delta: A controls only two Mountains, both used for Tormenting Voice.
variants.expected: Fiery Temper is exiled when discarded; the madness cost {R} cannot be paid, so it is put into A's graveyard. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: no_madness
variants.delta: A's hand holds Shock instead of Fiery Temper and A discards Shock.
variants.expected: Shock goes directly to A's graveyard: it is not exiled and no madness trigger exists. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: After an uncast madness card reaches the graveyard, an effect referring to the discarded card finds it there

setup.notes: Containment Construct is a 2/1 colorless artifact creature whose only ability is 'Whenever you discard a card, you may exile that card from your graveyard. If you do, you may play that card this turn.'

decisions: A casts Tormenting Voice, tapping two Mountains, discarding Fiery Temper as its additional cost; Fiery Temper is exiled by madness.
The madness trigger and Containment Construct's trigger trigger together. A puts Containment Construct's trigger on the stack first and the madness trigger on top of it.
The madness trigger resolves: A does not cast Fiery Temper, and it is put into A's graveyard.
Containment Construct's trigger resolves: A chooses to exile the discarded card from the graveyard.
Both players pass; Tormenting Voice resolves.

variants.label: uncast_then_found
variants.expected: Containment Construct's trigger finds Fiery Temper in A's graveyard and exiles it; Fiery Temper is in exile and A may play it this turn. A draws two cards.

variants.label: cast_with_madness
variants.delta: When the madness trigger resolves, A casts Fiery Temper for {R} (tapping the third Mountain) targeting player B; it resolves before Containment Construct's trigger.
variants.expected: Fiery Temper deals 3 damage to B (life 20 to 17) and is put into A's graveyard as a new object; Containment Construct's trigger cannot find the discarded card and exiles nothing. Fiery Temper stays in A's graveyard. A draws two cards.

variants.label: construct_trigger_first
variants.delta: A orders the triggers the other way: Containment Construct's trigger is on top and resolves before the madness trigger.
variants.expected: When Containment Construct's trigger resolves Fiery Temper is still in exile, not in the graveyard, so nothing is exiled from the graveyard. The madness trigger then resolves, A does not cast Fiery Temper, and it is put into A's graveyard, where it stays. A draws two cards.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge resolves Containment Construct's trigger through Defined$ TriggeredCard with Origin$ Graveyard; whether that reference follows the card from madness exile to the graveyard (fires variant) and loses it after the card was cast (cast_with_madness) depends on Forge's LKI handling, so either may be a Forge discrepancy.
